description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the Compabase database. Use when dedicated tools are not enough (aggregations, joins, custom analysis). Returns at most row_limit rows per call depending on the plan (Free 100, Pro 500, Scale 1000); if truncated is true, aggregate inside SQL (GROUP BY, COUNT, AVG, percentile_cont) instead of listing raw rows.

query.description: A read-only SQL SELECT or WITH…SELECT statement.

name: execute_sql
title: Execute Read-Only SQL
